title: a selector that names no path (a worktree name) still needs Orca's folder to be a worktree of the repo
source: intended: owner decision, defect N-22: the folder Orca reports is checked on every launch
intent: INTENDED behavior (owner decision, defect N-22). A selector with no path (wt-1, feature/x-1) has no pre-check, but the folder Orca reports must still be a worktree of the repo: another folder is refused with the plain 'untrusted folder' text, the terminal is closed and nothing is registered.
